name: aimemory
description: AI Memory Framework for Codex: loads a project's Memory.md and recent DynamicMemory.md entries at session start, blocks finishing a turn with unlogged file changes until the work is logged, and adds aimemory-pull/save/update/path/init/list/search/pause/status skills.

interface.shortDescription: Shared project memory for Claude Code and Codex
interface.longDescription: Keeps a plain-Markdown memory store (Projects.md, per-project Memory.md and DynamicMemory.md) that any coding agent can read and append to. At session start the plugin detects the project from the working folder and injects its memory; when a turn changed project files, the Stop hook requires a log entry before the agent can finish. Skills: $aimemory-pull, $aimemory-save, $aimemory-update, $aimemory-path, $aimemory-init, $aimemory-list, $aimemory-search, $aimemory-pause, $aimemory-status.
defaultPrompt: Use $aimemory-pull to load this project's memory.
Use $aimemory-save to log the work we just did.
